name: caller
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x LIMIT 1

name: tuple
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x,n.callee_name AS y LIMIT 2

name: graph
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x,n.graphId AS g LIMIT 1

name: skip
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x,n.callee_name AS y SKIP 1 LIMIT 1

name: nohit
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'absent-long-needle-for-preflight' RETURN DISTINCT n.callee_name AS x LIMIT 1
